golden: python model of the published G3PLX PSK31 Varicode table (fldigi pskvaricode.cxx via ckoval7/pydigi; ARRL psk31-spec + Wikipedia cross-check)
character_set: FULL ASCII 0..127 through the real SramPanelDevice/PanelDriver push-read + on-chip emit cell; plus a message ('the quick brown fox...' + edge), edge chars, random (3 seeds)
sram_pack_format: (length<<10)|code, 14 bits used per 16-bit word (10 code + 4 length; Varicode codes <=10 bits)
resolves_walls: TABLE SIZE (INV-29): 128-entry table moved off-cell into the unbounded SRAM panel (address == ASCII code point), replacing the ~21-entry LOAD-indirect ceiling.

VARIABLE-LENGTH EMIT (INV-29): each entry packs into ONE fixed 16-bit word; the panel push-read returns a fixed word per symbol, and the emit cell derives the emit count from the packed length nibble (not a data-dependent burst across the panel port).
bug_found: emit loop dropped bits: MOVE R0,len does not set the Z flag, so BR.NZ was branching on the last-emitted bit value instead of the counter. Fixed by adding OR R0, R{len} before the branch to set flags from the counter.
reusable_pattern: yes -- the load(pack table into panel via controller write path)/lookup(push-read into a small unpack+emit cell) recipe is directly copyable by VaricodeDecoderBlock (1024-entry reverse map) and the CW/Morse table blocks.
